Lora Davis, who practices law in Dallas, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law. She graduated in 1998. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1998.
